title_zh: 台风“红霞”登陆广东惠州
title_en: Typhoon 'Hongxia' Makes Landfall in Huizhou, Guangdong
summary_zh: 2026年7月25日，台风“红霞”加强为强台风，中央气象台发布今年首个台风红色预警，预计登陆广东惠州。
summary_en: On July 25, 2026, Typhoon 'Hongxia' intensified into a severe typhoon, and the National Meteorological Center issued the first red alert for typhoon this year, with landfall expected in Huizhou, Guangdong.
